blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of Santo Tomas (UST) has suspended four student activists who faced disciplinary complaints following a confrontation with military personnel at a Philippine Air Force (PAF) exhibit on campus last April 21. The Varsitarian, UST’s official student publication, reported on Monday, Oct. 5, that the university’s Office of Student Affairs had issued separate resolutions addressing two complaints—one filed by the PAF and another by an alumnus who expressed concern over the incident. The resolutions said the students—Sean Capalar, Dex Frogoso, Ralph Manuel, and Raven Racelis—violated UST’s Code of Conduct by failing to uphold the university’s principles and […]...
